description: Returns the full context document for a UIForge project from the centralized store. This is the absolute source of truth for project architecture, status, requirements, and roadmap. Pass the project slug (e.g. "forge-patterns"). Use list_projects to discover available projects.

project.description: Project slug to retrieve context for (e.g. forge-patterns, uiforge-webapp, uiforge-mcp, mcp-gateway)

name: get_project_context
